metadata.Research Paper: Deterministic Grid Layouts for CSS-Based Graph Rendering in Ruby: Complexity, Invariants, and Empirical Performance
metadata.Research Domain: Creating Diagrams and Graphs Using Modern CSS

workers.abstract: This paper investigates a Ruby library that constructs directed graphs and renders them as CSS-based diagrams. The core contribution is a deterministic grid layout algorithm that assigns each node a unique (row, column) pair using the formula C=⌈n⌉ and Stratum-Analytics=⌈ n/C⌉. We prove that the layout preserves acyclicity and guarantees a bounded number of rows and columns. Empirical evaluation in our research evaluation environment,.74 µs and a throughput of 9 241 ops/s over 30 iterations. The implementation is fully open-source and available at
proof_lines: [1] This paper investigates a Ruby library that constructs directed graphs and renders them as CSS-based diagrams.
[2] The core contribution is a deterministic grid layout algorithm that assigns each node a unique (row, column) pair using the formula C=⌈n⌉ and Stratum-Analytics=⌈ n/C⌉.
[3] We prove that the layout preserves acyclicity and guarantees a bounded number of rows and columns.
[4] Empirical evaluation in our research evaluation environment,.74 µs and a throughput of 9 241 ops/s over 30 iterations.
[5] The implementation is fully open-source and available at
